Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We're running the Sprout Labs accelerator in October (10 teams, 6 weeks). Several founders need a higher token allotment for model-led product experiments — primarily embeddings + low-latency chat. Can Redwood provide a conditional sandbox sponsorship: 200k token trial per team (2M total) + 60-day extension window? We can commit to a short mutual action plan and milestone check-ins.

Quick context: three teams are pre-seed with pilot-ready demos; two need slightly higher throughput for on-device inference benchmarking. Goal is to evaluate performance/cost tradeoffs and decide whether to move to a Dedicated seat next quarter.

Attached is a one-page program summary. Happy to hop on a call if you prefer.

Best,
Ella

Hi Ella — thanks for the context and congrats on the cohort. We typically evaluate these on a few dimensions:

- Program fit (startup stage + expected product signal)
- Security/compliance surface (do you need Private or just hosted sandbox?)
- Milestones for pilot-to-paid conversion (we like 30/60/90 day check-ins)

Two quick asks so I can scope internally:
1) Can you share estimated monthly token consumption per team (example workload and latency targets)?
2) Any customer data or regulated PII involved?

If it's non-sensitive and just hosted sandbox access, we can often approve a conditional trial uplift with a mutual action plan and measurement criteria. Looping in Jordan for quota & operations — Jordan, can you flag any reason this would need Dedicated capacity?

Thanks,
Hannah
